rules: Read CURRENT.json or LATEST.md first; do not search old chat threads for latest asset identity.
Frozen files are immutable. A later iteration creates a new version and supersession record; it never overwrites the historical frozen payload.
CURRENT.json is the only mutable latest-pointer file.
Candidate and production-baseline status are separate; freezing a candidate does not activate it.
Every frozen repository asset should carry SHA-256, lineage, status and repository path where materialized.
Execution-contract assets marked IMPLEMENTATION_PENDING are architecture commitments, not completed implementations.
